summary_short.zh: Servo是一个基于Rust编写的实验性浏览器引擎，旨在为嵌入式网页内容提供高性能渲染方案。其核心利用Rust的内存安全与并行处理能力，通过细粒度任务隔离实现快速安全的渲染。开发者可将Servo作为模块化组件集成到桌面或移动应用中，构建定制浏览器功能，或通过研究其设计学习现代系统编程对网页技术栈的优化。该项目展示了用安全系统语言重构浏览器核心的路径，为嵌入式网页渲染需求提供了灵活技术基础。

summaries.en: Servo is an experimental web browser engine written in Rust that provides a high-performance alternative for embedding web content in applications. Its key innovation is using Rust's memory safety and parallelism to process web pages with exceptional speed and security through fine-grained task isolation. Developers can integrate Servo as a rendering component in desktop or mobile apps, experiment with its modular architecture to build custom browser features, or study its implementation to learn modern systems programming techniques for web technologies.

summary_short.zh: RuView 是一个基于 Rust 的开源项目，通过普通 WiFi 信号实现实时人体姿态估计和生命体征监测，无需摄像头，解决了监控和医疗场景中的隐私问题。其核心技术在于利用 WiFi 信道状态信息（CSI），捕捉人体运动和呼吸引起的细微信号变化，通过信号处理和机器学习算法重建姿态与生理数据。开发者可将它集成到智能家居系统中进行存在检测，尝试用于老年人跌倒监测，或基于现有算法扩展新的感知应用，仅需常规 WiFi 硬件即可实验。

summaries.en: RuView is an open-source Rust project that transforms ordinary WiFi signals into real-time human pose estimation and vital sign monitoring without cameras, addressing privacy concerns in surveillance and healthcare. It leverages WiFi's Channel State Information (CSI) to detect subtle signal variations caused by human movement and breathing, using signal processing and machine learning to reconstruct pose and physiological data. Developers can integrate it into smart home systems for presence detection, experiment with fall detection for elderly care, or extend its algorithms to new sensing applications using commodity WiFi hardware.
